stow_hull.note: PADDLE_STOW: lying along the long axis on the left (non-braid, -X) brim strip outside the opening (x -4.37 to -6.06), its bow end slightly past the brim; build.py sets its scale to 1/aquatic_scale (hat_vessel.json) so the stowed stick matches the one in the braid.

wetline.note: Wet felt on the near-black cloth reads as a deeper, bluer, saturated film (darker than the dry felt above it; D 3.2's plain darker band is invisible on this hat), strongest at the water and thinning toward the brim, with one thin glossy thread just above the waterline (line_lift rows) so it is not lost under the water surface; the white band turns grey-blue where it is wet.
